subject: Order form: invoicing trigger & min-commit phasing — clarifying ask
messages:
From: Elliot Stone <elliot@brightline.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightline.io
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form: pricing schedule + invoicing path — question

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has a couple questions about the order form you sent (attached: orderform_draft_v3.pdf). Two things blocking internal approval:

1) Invoice trigger — the current language invoices on "activation". Our accounting requires invoices only on "service commencement" (i.e., full tenant provisioning + first production token usage). Can Redwood accept an invoice trigger tied to commencement instead of activation?

2) Minimum commit phasing — we'd like the first tranche to be billed pro rata on the first invoice and subsequent tranches quarterly. Your order form looks like annual upfront sizing. Can we align on a tranche schedule (quarterly draws) and corresponding invoice timings?

Also, we need to confirm tax handling: Brightline is VAT-registered in the UK — can you confirm entity and remit guidance so we know whether to apply reverse charge?

If helpful, I can send a short redline from procurement. Ideally we get this wrapped this week — do you have a suggested contact on legal/finance at Redwood to expedite?

Best,
Elliot
Procurement Lead
Brightline AI

- Tranche schedule: sales is flexible on phasing; Karthik — can you propose a quarterly draw schedule and the commercial implication on pricing bands (if any)?

Subject: RE: Order Form: pricing schedule + invoicing path — question

Naomi / team — taking this on. Draft guidance and suggested redline summary below (I will attach a tracked-changes doc). High level: we can accept the commencement trigger and a quarterly tranche schedule, but need precise definitions and a clean PO/invoice routing to avoid multi-entity exposure.

Proposed clause (short):
"Service Commencement" means the date on which Redwood has completed tenant provisioning for the Customer's production environment and the Customer has initiated the first production request resulting in billable token consumption. Invoices for the Initial Commitment shall be issued within 5 business days after Service Commencement.

Tranche handling (summary):
- Initial tranche: pro-rata for remainder of first quarter, invoiced at Service Commencement.
- Subsequent tranches: invoiced on the first business day of each calendar quarter thereafter (Quarterly Invoicing).

Tax/entity notes:
- Marissa, please confirm invoicing entity. If Brightline wants invoices from Redwood UK (to use reverse charge), we need their VAT registration number and billing remit details (company name + registered address).
- If invoices are issued by Redwood US, VAT treatment will follow local reverse charge guidance but may require gross-up in Brightline's AP process.

Attachments I will provide: redlines_brightline_kp_track.docx (legal), short clause map.

I will prepare the tracked redline and a brief legal summary for procurement. If Brightline sends their procurement markup, I'll incorporate and aim for sign-off with Marissa by EOD tomorrow.

Kimberly Park
Senior Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order Form: pricing schedule + invoicing path — question

Looping in finance confirmation. Short answers:

- Preferred invoicing entity: Redwood UK (we can invoice from Redwood UK for Brightline to leverage reverse charge), subject to Brightline providing a valid UK VAT number and billing address on company letterhead or within their PO.
- Invoice timing acceptance: OK to invoice at Service Commencement as Kimberly drafted; we will mark initial invoice as prorated and subsequent invoices quarterly.
- Net terms: Standard Net30 is acceptable; finance can approve Net45 for enterprise accounts but that requires an approval ticket — Naomi, do we need to offer Net45 for this deal?

Attachments: I will confirm the exact invoice remit name and provide the Redwood UK remit details if Brightline confirms VAT registration. Also attaching a short AP checklist we send to procurement to speed processing (copy pasted in the redline doc).

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Once we have those, Kimberly will incorporate your markup and we will return a consolidated tracked-orderform and a DocuSign-ready file.
